\[
37,203 - 34,590 = 2,613
\]

\[
\text{Growth percentage}=\frac{2,613}{34,590}=\frac{2613}{34590}
\]

Applying the same growth percentage to the 2025 population:

\[
37,203 \times \left(1+\frac{2613}{34590}\right)
=37,203 \times \frac{37203}{34590}
=40,012.626771...
\]

This exceeds 40,000 residents.
